summary: PASS28: all seven size-sixteen cases are excluded, including the eight-vertex (3,2) type; together with the reviewed dependencies, both D1-associated components have size at least14.

obligations.title: Actual graph scope and orientation
obligations.check: A is the original symmetric adjacency matrix; r_CD counts neighbors in D from C. The imported actual quotient R²+R=10I+1nᵀ has nonnegative integer entries and satisfies component edge balance.

obligations.title: Whole-component types
obligations.check: Equitability makes (d_H,d_K) constant on each exterior B-component, so every joint type is a union of whole components; it need not be a single component.

obligations.title: Even component and type sizes
obligations.check: B has integer weights and row sum three, so 3|E| is twice the total unordered B-weight. Each component and each type has even size, without using B≤2.

obligations.title: Joint and individual divisibilities
obligations.check: For a type T_ij, each vertex of H has an integer common number of neighbors in T_ij; edge balance gives 12|iN_ij. Similarly 16|jN_ij. The same argument applies to a single component within a type, including zero-coordinate cases.

obligations.title: Exact moment specialization
obligations.check: Substituting h=12,k=16,a=4,b=3 into the accepted formulas gives N=34, Sx=48−12s, Fx=72−12s², Sy=80−16t, Fy=144−16t², C=48(3−s−t).

obligations.title: Pointwise domain
obligations.check: The distinct components and degree eight give x+y≤8. Keeping H and K terms in the actual neighbor identities gives (s+1)x+3y≤12 and 4x+(t+1)y≤16; all omitted contributions are nonnegative.

obligations.title: Actual component-vector identity
obligations.check: B1_L=3·1_L implies (A²+A)1_L=10·1_L+|L|·1. At every vertex outside L, (A d_L)+d_L=|L|. No invariance of an individual component under A is assumed.

obligations.title: Complete mixed-coordinate domain
obligations.check: With s,t≥0 and x,y positive, x+3y≤12 and 4x+y≤16 give 1≤x,y≤3. Thus the nine displayed types exhaust mixed possibilities.

obligations.title: Divisor table
obligations.check: The values lcm(2,12/gcd(12,x),16/gcd(16,y)) are exactly 48,24,48,48,24,48,16,8,16 in the displayed row-major order.

obligations.title: First mixed exclusions
obligations.check: A positive divisor-48 type exceeds the total 34. Types (3,1),(3,3) require at least 16 vertices and factorial x contribution 96>Fx≤72.

obligations.title: Type (2,2) exclusion
obligations.check: Its size would be exactly 24. It contributes Sx=48, impossible for s>0. For s=0 it exhausts Sx but contributes only Fx=48<72, so no other vertex can repair the deficit.

obligations.title: Both surviving mixed sizes
obligations.check: The only candidates are P=(1,2) with 24 vertices and M=(3,2) with eight. A second multiple for M contributes at least 96 to Fx. This explicitly retains the formerly omitted M possibility.

obligations.title: No coexistence and cross moment
obligations.check: P and M together contribute Sx=48,Fx=48. This exceeds Sx when s>0 and exhausts it with an Fx deficit when s=0. Each alone contributes C=48, so C is zero or 48.

obligations.title: Cases (0,0),(0,1)
obligations.check: Their required cross moments are 144 and 96, respectively, contradicting the preceding complete possibilities.

obligations.title: Case (0,2)
obligations.check: M violates 4x+3y≤16. P therefore occurs, exhausts Sy=48, and contributes only Fy=48 rather than the required 80.

obligations.title: Case (2,0)
obligations.check: M violates 3x+3y≤12. P exhausts Sx=24 but contributes Fx=0 rather than the required 24.

obligations.title: Case (1,1), P branch
obligations.check: After P, the residual x moments are Sx=12,Fx=60. The pointwise bound x≤4 gives x(x−1)≤3x, hence Fx≤36, contradiction.

obligations.title: Case (1,1), M residual
obligations.check: After the eight M vertices, residual positive x types are pure with Sx=Fx=12. Divisibility makes nonempty x=3 contribute at least 24 and x=4 at least 72 to Fx. Therefore precisely six vertices have type (2,0), with no type (1,0).

obligations.title: Individual M and X components
obligations.check: Every component inside M has size divisible by eight, so the eight-vertex M is one component. Every component inside X=T20 has size divisible by six, so the six-vertex X is one component.

obligations.title: Actual (1,1) neighbor equations
obligations.check: d_H is 1 on H, 3 on K and M, 2 on X, and zero elsewhere. At v∈M the identity is 12=3+6+3d_M(v)+2d_X(v)+3, forcing no M−X edges. At v∈X it is 12=2+2d_X(v)+2, forcing d_X(v)=4.

obligations.title: Quotient diagonal contradiction
obligations.check: For the actual six-vertex component X, R_XX=4. Its diagonal quotient equation has nonnegative other terms and gives R_XX²+R_XX≤|X|+10=16, contradicting 20.

obligations.title: Case (2,1), positive x support
obligations.check: C=0 makes positive x and y supports disjoint. Summing x−1≤x(x−1)/2 over positive x gives |U|≥24−24/2=12.

obligations.title: Case (2,1), pure y counts
obligations.check: Writing N01=16a,N02=8b,N03=16c,N04=4d gives a+b+3c+d=4 and b+6c+3d=8. Nonnegative integer solutions force c=0,d=2,b=2,a=0. Thus |V|=24 and |U|+|V|≥36>34.

obligations.title: Case (1,2), pure x counts
obligations.check: x≤4 and six-point minimum for x=4 exclude that type by Fx≥72>60. The remaining equations give u=3w−24,v=30−3w,8≤w≤10 and 4|w; hence N30=8,N20=6,N10=0.

obligations.title: Case (1,2), pure y counts and exhaustion
obligations.check: A y=3 type contributes at least 96>80. For counts a=N01,b=N02,d=N04, a=8d−32,b=40−6d and 4≤d≤6 with 4|d force d=4,b=16,a=0. The four nonzero types total 34, leaving no zero type.

obligations.title: Case (1,2), neighbors of type (0,4)
obligations.check: Such a vertex z exists. Its four K neighbors each have d_H=3 and exhaust the right side 12 in the H identity. Thus z has no neighbor in either positive x exterior type and no neighbor in H.

obligations.title: Final original-graph contradiction
obligations.check: Degree eight and the exhausted exterior list force the other four neighbors of z into T04∪T02. All eight neighbors have d_K≥2, while d_K(z)=4. The K identity gives 16=(A d_K)(z)+4≥20.

obligations.title: Coverage and combined consequence
obligations.check: All seven listed cases are excluded. The reviewed minimum-size and exact-separator results restrict H12 to five partner sizes; the reviewed pure twelve, two-large-partner, and twenty-zero-two exclusions remove all other options. Hence H≠12 and H≥14 by evenness. The previously reviewed K12 reduction and exclusion give K≥14. H=K was already ≥14 in the minimum-size source.

essential_local_imports: Exact exterior moment and pointwise identities
details.combined_conclusion: Every D1 heavy component H and its generated-triangle component K have size at least14, possibly H=K; conditional on named reviewed imports.
